title: DXF LAYER independent color-group order retention
status: bounded implementation with focused validation; no broader support claim
problem: Parsing a group 62 after groups 420 or 430 clears RGB and color-name state even though the fields are independently supplied and DXF group order cannot be assumed. A negative group 62 remains the signed ACI/off state.
change: For a LAYER group 62 update the ACI only while retaining already observed 420/430 and their retained-string accounting; retain existing DWG CMC metadata reset. Per-layer reset still clears previous rows. No public class, vtable or ABI changes.

sources.relevance: Warns not to assume group order.
Group ranges 420 and 430 encode true colors and color names.

physical_observations.tool: ODA File Converter 27.1, ACAD2013 DWG then ACAD2013 DXF; local invocation observed manually, hashes bind files but do not prove the converter lineage
physical_observations.source_layer: COLORCHECK; ODA-returned groups 62=-148 and 420=1193046; input ACI was -7. ODA changed ACI fallback while preserving signed off state and true color.
physical_observations.projection: The selected record is copied from ODA output into an independently auditable minimal AC1027 DXF. A second projection swaps only the adjacent 62 and 420 groups, as verified by the audit; this alternate ordering is a controlled edit, not claimed to be ODA-authored.
physical_observations.black: Separately authored BLACKCHECK input carried 62=7 and explicit 420=0; ODA return carried 62=18 and explicit 420=0. Both inputs and output have zero ezdxf 1.4.5 audit errors and fixes.
physical_observations.before: A native probe linked to unmodified 156b3946 read the reordered projection as color=-148, color24=-1. The fixed probe reads color=-148, color24=1193046.

validation.native: Focused CTest passes all six input permutations of 62/420/430 in ASCII and binary, selected source output/reread in both encodings, signed ACI, 420=0 versus absent, color name without RGB, duplicate fields last-wins per field, per-record reset and failed-read corrected same-reader retry.
validation.existing: Existing libdxfrw_layer_dwg_cmc_roundtrip CTest passes, and lc3_compat_check object compiles.
validation.peer: ezdxf 1.4.5 validates physical source, both selected projections, both output encodings and explicit-black input/output with no audit errors or fixes; audit under python -O enforces input hashes and rereads them afterward.
validation.librecad: Read-only inspection of LibreCAD RS_FilterDXFRW addLayer/attributesToPen shows the callback reads color24 when present and colorName when present; the existing legacy 2D adapter compile guard succeeds. No native LibreCAD application or rendering test is claimed.

limits: This qualifies selected color fields, not full physical-source graph or file roundtrip.
A 430 color name is existing libdxfrw transport behavior exercised synthetically; the physical producer witness contains 420 only. No color-book rendering or unspecified precedence is claimed.
Duplicate-group tests document current per-field last-value behavior, not a claim of ODA behavior for malformed duplicates.
Physical DWG/DXF sample files stay outside the repository; no binary fixtures are added.
